Saving country comparative plots to .pdf file(s)

Source: R/plots_comparative.R
save_plots_comparative_all.Rd

Function for generating and saving side-by-side comparative plots of MRC projection results for all countries across two or more scenarios. Outputs can be saved either as a single combined PDF file or as separate PDF files per country.

Usage

save_plots_comparative_all(
  projection_objects,
  single_file = TRUE,
  folder = "comparative",
  demographic_plots = TRUE,
  switching_plots,
  migration_plots,
  show_post_switch = TRUE,
  plot_colors = c("blue3", "green4", "red3", "yellow3", "orange3", "purple3", "grey40",
    "darkblue", "darkgreen", "red4", "yellow4", "orange4", "purple4", "grey30"),
  progress_bar = TRUE
)

Arguments

projection_objects

List; resolved projection objects to compare against each other

single_file

Logical; if TRUE, saves all country plots into a single .pdf file (default TRUE)

folder

Character; name of folder in which plots should be saved (default "comparative")

demographic_plots

Logical; if FALSE, skips creation of fertility and mortality plots (default TRUE)

switching_plots

Logical; if FALSE, skips creation of switching plots. Defaults to the first projection object's switching status

migration_plots

Logical; if FALSE, skips creation of migration plots. Defaults to the first projection object's migration status

show_post_switch

Logical; if TRUE, post-switch populations are visualized separately. Forced to FALSE if any projection has post_switch disabled. The per-religion population plots always show the full religion (base plus post-switch) (default TRUE)

plot_colors

Character vector; colors used for each religion in the plots (recommended to leave unchanged unless the number of religions has changed)

progress_bar

Logical; whether to show a progress bar during saving (default TRUE)

Value

Called for its side effects. Saves comparative country plots as PDF file(s) to `folder` and prints a completion message.

See also

save_plots_all for single-scenario country plots. save_plots_comparative_regions_all for the region-level equivalent. vignette("visualising-projections") for a guide to all comparative plot types and how the content flags map to type numbers.

Examples

# Running a full projection is time-consuming.
# Wrapped in dontrun to avoid executing during documentation build.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
projection_dsm <- create_projection_object(name = "dsm", switching = TRUE)
projection_dm <- create_projection_object(name = "dm", switching = FALSE)
project(projection_object = projection_dsm)
project(projection_object = projection_dm)
save_plots_comparative_all(
  projection_objects = list(projection_dsm, projection_dm),
  folder = tempdir(),
  progress_bar = FALSE
)
} # }
